messages.subject: oneStepPredict() with composition data
parts:
Hi y'all,

I want to calculate OSA residuals for my TMB model and have found success using oneStepPredict() on the total catch data (a data vector), but not the catch compositions (a data matrix). I get warnings and indexing errors when I try.

Is it possible to use oneStepPredict() on composition data? 
For those using WHAM, I note that in that code, a single vector with all observations "obsvec" is made to help run the oneStepPredict() function. Is that necessary in my case too, perhaps?

Any insight greatly appreciated,
Emily Liljestrand
Michigan State University
